title: 3727. Maximum Alternating Sum of Squares

examples.explanation: A possible rearrangement for nums is [2,1,3], which gives the maximum alternating score among all possible rearrangements. The alternating score is calculated as: score = 22 - 12 + 32 = 4 - 1 + 9 = 12

A possible rearrangement for nums is [-3,-1,-2,1,3,2], which gives the maximum alternating score among all possible rearrangements. The alternating score is calculated as: score = (-3)2 - (-1)2 + (-2)2 - (1)2 + (3)2 - (2)2 = 9 - 1 + 4 - 1 + 9 - 4 = 16
